about: Starter options for the three project lanes. Each option names a real starter in the repo's research notes, one measurable success test, and what devnet evidence it can produce. These are suggestions to start from, not a menu you must pick from. Facts come from research/experiments (VERDICT.md and each FINDINGS.md, checked 20-21 Oct 2026).
safety: Reads use public mainnet data; every write is devnet only; no real funds. Judged on utility, tests, devnet evidence and a clear explanation, never on simulated returns.

lanes.title: Agent
lanes.blurb: A trading agent or strategy with honest validation.

options.title: Label my own strategy
options.pitch: Run a strategy's past decisions through the triple-barrier labeler and show how often it really wins, with costs.
options.firstTest: Labels for at least 50 decisions, and the share of wins whose barrier is wider than the round-trip cost.
options.devnetEvidence: A Memo transaction for the first 3 labelled decisions (npm run memo).
options.from: 0004 demo-repo/code (labeler) and the strategies in 0002 demo-repo/code/src/strategies
options.caveat: A calm 40-minute window; do not generalise.

options.title: Build the second-opinion gate
options.pitch: Add your own features to the gate and measure which blocked trades were right to block, on a purged split.
options.firstTest: Gate hit rate versus no-gate hit rate on the test period, shown with the +/- range, plus the number of purged training trades.
options.devnetEvidence: A Memo transaction per gate decision batch with a hash of the decision file.
options.caveat: Few trades means a wide +/- range: say so in the brief.

options.title: Explanation checker for an LLM agent
options.pitch: Flag written reasons whose facts contradict the data the agent had; grade reasons against what happened.
options.firstTest: Catches every injected wrong claim in out/agent.json and raises no false alarm on true ones, then runs on 20 reasons from your own agent.
options.devnetEvidence: A Memo transaction with the hash of each flagged reason.
options.needs: Node 24. An LLM is optional: the offline pretend agent works without AI credits.
options.caveat: It checks facts, not whether the trade idea is good.

options.title: Agent with a risk hook and a label log
options.pitch: Combine the build night 1 risk hook, the CUSUM wake-up and labels into one agent that logs every decision and its outcome.
options.firstTest: A 1-hour recorded replay where every decision has a label, a guard result and a log row, with tests for the guard.
options.devnetEvidence: A devnet Memo log of the decisions, checked against the local log.
options.needs: Node 24, a throwaway devnet key funded by a lead.
options.caveat: More moving parts: agree the smallest version first.

lanes.title: Exchange
lanes.blurb: A venue component: order book, matching, deposit or custody flow.

options.title: Deposit watcher
options.pitch: Watch a devnet address and credit users in an append-only ledger when a transfer arrives.
options.firstTest: A real devnet transfer shows up as one ledger row with signature and slot, and a replayed duplicate is ignored.
options.devnetEvidence: The ledger row and the transaction link on the devnet explorer.
options.from: research/experiments/deposit-watcher (proven end to end on devnet: a 0.021 SOL transfer was credited about 1 s after confirmation)
options.needs: A throwaway devnet key; devnet SOL from a lead (the public faucet rate-limits hard).
options.caveat: Uses the older web3.js v1 on purpose (one-line log subscription).

options.title: Mini order book
options.pitch: Write a price-time-priority matching engine and settle its trades as devnet Memo records.
options.firstTest: The 10-order fixture gives exactly the 5 hand-checked trades; add a test for a partial fill and a cancel.
options.devnetEvidence: Settlement Memo transactions (the starter's settle step was blocked only by the devnet faucet when tested).
options.needs: Node 24; devnet SOL from a lead for the settle step.
options.caveat: Matching is the point, not speed.

options.title: Orca Whirlpool devnet lab
options.pitch: Use the Whirlpools SDK on devnet: find a pool, quote a swap, and write a small tool around it.
options.firstTest: Fetch a devnet SOL/devUSDC pool, decode it and quote one swap; a test checks the quote against the pool's price.
options.devnetEvidence: A devnet pool address and a read-only quote; a swap transaction if funded.
options.needs: Node 24, devnet SOL from a lead for any write.
options.caveat: Orca's licence allows university courses; it is not a permissive open-source licence. The SDK uses web3.js v2 (@solana/kit).

options.title: Read a real on-chain order book (Phoenix)
options.pitch: Read the Phoenix devnet ladder and implement one pure module (tick and lot conversion or an event decoder) with tests.
options.firstTest: Your module reproduces the SDK's ladder numbers for one devnet market.
options.from: research/experiments/phoenix-v1 (MIT since May 2026; use the current master only)
options.needs: Node 24; Rust only if you read the program.
options.caveat: The TypeScript SDK is old (marked Phoenix Legacy); expect to read source.

lanes.title: Tooling
lanes.blurb: Anything that helps the trading process: data, monitoring, risk, explainability, dashboards.

options.title: Data collector for another market
options.pitch: Record real prices for a token other than SOL and publish the file with its provenance.
options.firstTest: A recorded file of at least 30 minutes with a SOURCES.md, and a test that loads it.
options.devnetEvidence: A Memo transaction with the file's hash.
options.caveat: Public endpoints rate-limit a shared campus connection: poll slowly.

options.title: Change and staleness monitor
options.pitch: Watch a price feed and alert when it moves (CUSUM) or goes stale (age and slots behind).
options.firstTest: On the recorded 26-minute Pyth series the monitor flags the same stale spans as build night 2's checker.
options.devnetEvidence: A Memo transaction when an alert fires (devnet only).
options.caveat: The frozen-feed fault in 0003 is simulated.

options.title: Label and gate dashboard
options.pitch: A page that shows an agent's decisions, labels, gate result and report card for any recorded file.
options.firstTest: Loads out/labels.json and out/agent.json and shows the same counts as npm run demo.
options.devnetEvidence: Link each shown decision to its Memo transaction when present.
options.from: 0004 demo-repo/lab (copy a demo and change it)
options.caveat: Keep the Recorded/Live switch honest: label live data as live.

options.title: Leak checker for backtests
options.pitch: Given labelled events and a train/test split, report how many training labels reach into the test period and purge them.
options.firstTest: Matches the leaking count in out/overlap.json and removes exactly those labels, with tests.
options.devnetEvidence: A Memo transaction with the hash of the purged split.
options.caveat: Needs a clear definition of an event's start and end; write it down first.

availability: Free during the break (mid-Nov to early Jan)
